basics.name: Lloyd Villanueva
basics.label: Doctoral student in Radio and Space Science
basics.summary: Doctoral student at Chalmers University of Technology, studying Arctic clouds and their role in climate models. For a change of pace, I sometimes shift my focus to convective cold pools in lower latitudes. With a background in mathematical physics and data science, I aim to contribute new insights to atmospheric science and climate research.
